docs.title: Welcome to Mahol-Nama
docs.text:
Mahol-Nama is a web portal that disseminates a set of environmental monitoring and analytics applications, developed by undergraduate researchers at Habib University.

Mahol-Nama initiative is currently being supervised by Dr. Umer Tariq (Assistant Professor, ECE Program, Habib University) and is being supported by an Internal Faculty Research Grant at Habib University.

docs.title: About Mahol-Nama
docs.text:
MaholNama is a web portal that disseminates a set of environmental monitoring and analytics applications, developed by undergraduate researchers at Habib University.

MaholNama initiative is currently being supervised by Dr. Umer Tariq (Assistant Professor, ECE Program, Habib University) and is being supported by an Internal Faculty Research Grant at Habib University.

docs.title: Monitoring of Urban Expansion
docs.text:
• Urban Expansion in Karachi: Change Analysis over Customized Time Interval This app allows the user to choose a neighborhood in Karachi and compare the built-up area between any two months since 2020.

  • Developer: Jibran Sheikh (CS, Class of 2026, Habib University)

docs.title: Monitoring of Urban Greenery
docs.text:
• Continuous Monitoring and Ranking of Urban Parks in Karachi based on Greenspace Change This app allows the user to contiuously monitor urban parks in Karachi and rank them based on greenspace change over a span 6 months, 1 year, or 5 years. The user can also evaluate each park individually for detailed statistics about greenspace change.
  • Greenery in Karachi Parks: Change Analysis over Fixed Time Intervals This app allows the user to choose a park in Karachi and analyze the change in greenery over last 6 months, last year, or last 5 years.
  • Greenery in Karachi Parks: Change Analysis over Customized Time Intervals This app allows the user to choose a park in Karachi and compare the greenery between any two months since 2018.
  • Urban Greenery in Karachi Neighborhoods: Change Analysis over Fixed Time Intervals This app allows the user to choose a neighborhood in Karachi and analyze the change in urban greenery over last 6 months, last year, or last 5 years.

  • Urban Greenery in Karachi Neighborhoods: Change Analysis over Customized Time Intervals This app allows the user to choose a neighborhood in Karachi and compare the urban greenery between any two months since 2018.

  • Developer: Muhammad Daniyal Farooqui (CS, Class of 2026, Habib University).

docs.title: Monitoring of Weather Anomalies
docs.text:
• GEE Link: Launch Google Earth Engine App
  • Summary: This app supports historical pattern analysis of district-wise weather anomalies in Pakistan using ERA5 data.
  • Developer: Ghulam Mustafa (CS, Class of 2026, Habib University).

docs.title: Monitoring of Weather Anomalies
docs.text:
• District-Level Weather Anomalies in Pakistan: Historical Pattern Analysis This app supports historical pattern analysis of district-wise weather anomalies in Pakistan using ERA5 data.
  • District-Level Weather Anomalies in Pakistan: Near Real-Time Monitoring This app supports near real-time monitoring of district-wise weather anomalies in Pakistan using ERA5 data.

  • District-Level Weather Anomalies in Pakistan: Forecast This app compares 16-day weather forecast with the historical averages for the same 16-day period in order to identify the upcoming district-wise weather anomalies in Pakistan.

  • Developer: Ghulam Mustafa (CS, Class of 2026, Habib University)
